attchmntText: GRM Overseas Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: GRM Overseas Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, with the Bombay Stock Exchange and National Stock Exchange of India Limited on November 14, 2026. The presentation details unaudited financial results. For the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, total income was 453 crore rupees, representing a 22 percent year-over-year increase. EBITDA stood at 32 crore rupees, up 30 percent year-over-year. Profit after tax was 19 crore rupees, a 27 percent increase. For the first half of fiscal year 2027, total income reached 880 crore rupees, up 25 percent year-over-year. EBITDA was 68 crore rupees, up 21 percent. Profit after tax was 40 crore rupees, up 19 percent. The company targets 3,500 crore rupees in revenue by fiscal year 2028.

attchmntText: GRM Overseas Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Finacial Highlights of the Company for the half year ended 30th Sep, 2026".
voiceSummary: GRM Overseas Limited filed a press release regarding financial highlights for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Total income for Q2 FY27 was Rs. 453 Crores, up 21.9% year on year. EBITDA stood at Rs. 32 Crores, growing 30.2% year on year. Profit after tax increased 27.1% year on year to Rs. 19 Crores. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, total income was Rs. 880 Crores, up 24.6% year on year. The announcement was submitted to the Bombay Stock Exchange and National Stock Exchange of India Limited on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: GRM Overseas Limited filed a Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding the utilization of proceeds from a Preferential Issue of 90,70,000 Fully Convertible Warrants aggregating to Rs. 136.05 crore. The report by CARE Ratings Limited notes a deviation where the company utilized Rs. 0.06 crore for media consultancy, which was inadvertently omitted from earlier certificates but remains within the 25% limit for general corporate purposes. Additionally, a shareholder resolution dated September 29, 2026, revised the allocation of issue proceeds. This revision resulted in the allocation towards general corporate purpose exceeding the prescribed 25% limit due to an arithmetical error. The company is seeking fresh shareholder approval to rectify this error. The current allocation remains subject to this pending shareholder approval.

attchmntText: GRM Overseas Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: GRM Overseas Limited held a Board Meeting on November 14, 2026, to consider and approve the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were subjected to a limited review by statutory auditors Mehra Goel & Co LLP. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the consolidated revenue from operations was Rs 87,915.70 lakhs, and the net profit was Rs 4,016.58 lakhs. The basic earnings per share was Rs 1.90. The consolidated total assets as at September 30, 2026, stood at Rs 1,01,365.72 lakhs. The financial statements have been uploaded to the company website at www.grmrice.com.
